eth.name: Ethereum
eth.coming_reason: DeFi protocols, L2s, and infrastructure projects

subnets.name: TaoLend
subnets.description: Decentralized lending protocol for TAO and subnet alpha tokens. Users lend TAO, borrowers collateralize with alpha tokens.
bull_case: First mover in TAO DeFi — massive untapped market
128 subnets = 128 potential collateral types
Natural flywheel: more subnets → more collateral → stronger protocol
TAO staking derivative market could 10x addressable market
bear_case: Subnet alpha collateral could become worthless if subnets die
Collateral liquidation in volatile markets is untested
Major DeFi protocols could integrate TAO and compete
Anonymous team with limited track record

subnets.name: Dogelayer
subnets.description: First mining pool enabling Scrypt (LTC/DOGE) miners to join Bittensor via merged mining. Dual reward system.
bull_case: LTC/DOGE hashrate is enormous — 1% capture = transformative
TAO inflow proves validators see real economic value
Dual rewards: miners earn LTC/DOGE + alpha simultaneously
LTC halvening (Aug 2027) will drive miners to alternatives
bear_case: Centralized AWS proxy = single point of failure
Manual withdrawal is custodial (1-3 days)
LTC/DOGE price collapse eliminates miner incentive
Competition from InfiniteHash (BTC mining pool)

subnets.name: TensorClaw
subnets.description: Decentralized LLM inference subnet aggregating OpenAI, DeepSeek, Claude, and Llama APIs globally. Business API model routes real commercial traffic through miners.
bull_case: Business API = real revenue flowing through Bittensor
Solves API centralization, rate limits, censorship
Censorship-resistant AI for restricted countries
Sophisticated scoring: HA failover, anti-cheat, model whitelists
bear_case: Centralized AICenter = single point of failure
Big Tech has better latency, more models, better SLAs
Only 3 commits on GitHub — very early stage
Centralized router negates decentralization benefits

subnets.name: StreetVision
subnets.description: Decentralized computer vision subnet for roadwork detection via NATIX's Internet of Cameras. 1,046+ commits, MIT licensed.
bull_case: Physical AI = one of 2026's hottest investment themes
Real camera network = hardware moat pure software subnets lack
Expandable: traffic monitoring, disaster detection, smart cities
MIT licensed with professional codebase
bear_case: Narrow use case (roadwork detection) limits TAM
Google Street View, municipal cameras already do this
Camera network growth dependency
NATIX is a relatively unknown entity

subnets.name: InfiniteHash
subnets.description: BTC mining pool bridged to the Lightning Network. Brings SHA-256 hashrate into Bittensor — 286K TAO locked.
bull_case: BTC hashrate is 100x larger than LTC+DOGE
Post-BTC-halvening miner cost crisis = demand for alternatives
Lightning Network enables BTC↔TAO micropayment flows
Highest locked TAO = strongest commitment signal
bear_case: Direct competition with DogeLayer for the mining bridge narrative
BTC mining is highly centralized (Foundry, Antpool)
Lightning Network integration is technically complex
Less active development than DogeLayer
